items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
Min 2 years Professional, proactive, detail-oriented candidates with strong customer service skills and a passion for energy and sustainability issues and/or capital programs encouraged to apply.

The Administrative Officer provides administrative support to the Associate Vice President (AVP) and their organization, including Capital Programs, Energy & Sustainability at the University of California Office of the President (UCOP). Prioritizing a positive, customer service-focused approach while balancing multiple priorities, the Administrative Officer is detail-oriented and ensures the smooth flow of daily administrative operations. Responsibilities include helping manage the AVP's schedule, coordinating small and large meetings across various UC locations, streamlining procedures, and ensuring policy compliance in their work. Provides broad administrative support to departmental staff, including basic accounting, recharges and invoice management, travel planning and expense reports, and processing third-party agreements. Works closely with other executive assistants and departments at the Office of the President and other UC locations to support the AVP's goals and initiatives. Acts independently and proactively, exhibiting a high degree of professionalism, tact, and discretion.

25% Oversees and ensures the daily administrative operations run smoothly for the executive's office and larger organization with a detailed customer service approach. Handles the details of a variety of matters on behalf of the executive and department staff, and implements related business processes.

25% Coordinates travel, meeting, and interview arrangements involving multiple parties across various UC locations for the AVP and department staff. Suports logistical needs and develops itineraries including, but not limited to: airline/airport information, hotel information, meeting times, meeting participants, meeting location, agendas, and any other information that may be required. Supports conferences and committees sponsored by or held at the AVP's Offices, virtually, or other UC locations, including providing support materials for the conference, room reservations, catering, and various amenities for the participants.
25% Working with other UCOP departments, supports the AVP and department staff with basic accounting and invoice management, expense reports, and processing third-party agreements.

25% Independently serves as the coordination lead to staff UC-wide in determining the priorities, procedures and regulations in preparation of public reporting, outgoing correspondence, items for the Regents agenda, and reports to the Legislature and other government and state agencies. Organizes ad hoc committees appointed by the executive on a broad range of issues as needed for support.
Political acumen and sensitivities to the differing perspectives and political circumstances within all levels of the organization as well as the Office of the President and external constituencies.
Familiarity with the organization's processes, protocols and procedures.
Thorough knowledge of common organization-specific and other computer application programs.
Strong skills to communicate effectively with all levels of staff, faculty, alumni / donors, students and external constituencies, both verbally and in writing.
Ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes.
Ability to use high-level discretion and maintain a high level of confidentiality.
